method: Sector score = average 5-pillar composite of that sector's book names; trend/note cite this week's real session moves.

sectors.name: Energy
sectors.note: Energy led: Hormuz strike Sun Aug 30 sent Brent +~3.5% to ~$91; SLB +4.2% Fri, XOM/CVX +~1.5-1.7% premarket Mon.

sectors.name: Financials
sectors.note: Hawkish Fed (Sept hike odds ~60%) supports NII; JPM closed +1.0% Fri on a down tape.

sectors.name: Semiconductors
sectors.note: Semi rout Fri on the yield spike + NVDA's margin scare: NVDA -4.6%, ASML -2.2%, TSM -2.3%.

sectors.name: Software / AI
sectors.note: Quality mega-cap led the flight to safety: MSFT +1.7%, GOOGL +1.7%, NOW +4.5% green on a down-Nasdaq Fri.

sectors.name: Consumer / LatAm
sectors.note: Mixed: MELI +1.8% (quality bid) vs NU -3.9% (high-beta EM sold).

sectors.name: Industrials
sectors.note: Electrification names de-rated with the power complex: ETN -3.2%; GE roughly flat.

sectors.name: Healthcare
sectors.note: Defensive bid: ISRG +1.5% Fri; LLY/UNH roughly flat as cyclicals sold off.

sectors.name: Uranium & nuclear fuel
sectors.note: Uranium sold off with the nuclear/AI-power trade: CCJ -5.9% Fri, back below $100 on the yield spike.

sectors.name: AI power / nuclear
sectors.note: Rate-sensitive AI-power hit hardest: CCJ -5.9% (below $100), GEV -4.4%, CEG -2.0%, VST -1.9% to new lows.

sectors.name: Renewables
sectors.note: Renewables stayed weak on the yield spike: FSLR -2.7% (UBS did lift SEDG to Buy).
